name: Víznar (Spain)
description: Divided by a blue band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Víznar (a fountain, a tree and a palace).
history: Víznar adopted its arms and flag officially on 22 March 2001; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, divided by a blue diagonal band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green at the hoist and red at the fly, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly
